ahulap I

  • Meaning: (or ahulab), OB also ahulup, OB lex. ahulapum "(it is) enough!" OAkk, Bab.; as declaration of clemency by god, as petition for clemency by worshipper; jB šam a. (a plant name);
  • Lines: 35, 38, 55
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ahulap%20I

ahāzu I

  • Meaning: "to take; marry; learn"
    • G: (a/u)
    • Gt: "be connected with; well versed in"
    • D: (OA infin. also ehhuzum) "mount, plate, inlay" with metal, stone (< ihzu denom.) [GAR(.RA)]; "marry" pl.
    • Dt: pass. of D
    • Štn: "instruct, inform s.o. repeatedly"; OB of disease "infect repeatedly"
    • Št1: OB "be instructed, incited"?
    • Št2: lex. "ignite" fire, "make" fire "catch"
    • N: pass. of G 2 "marry each other"; of fire etc. "catch, spread";
  • Logograms: GAR, GAR.RA
  • Lines: 114
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ah%C4%81zu%20I

ai II

  • Lines: 78
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ai%20II

akāšu I

  • Meaning: "to walk, go" Bab., O/MA
    • G: (u/u) [DU] of messenger, person, snake
    • Gt: "go away"
    • D: "drive away, expel" person, disease, demon; ~ "press, push away" part of liver; OA stat. of tablet "is mislaid" ?
    • Dtn: iter. of D
    • Dt: pass. of D "be expelled, driven off"
  • Logograms: DU
  • Lines: 59
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ak%C4%81%C5%A1u%20I

amālu I

  • Meaning: ~ "to be veiled, covered" O/jB
    • G: (i/i) of eyes "mist over", of mood "become gloomy"
    • D: "veil; darken, eclipse", esp. stat. of star "is obscured"
    • Dt: pass. of D
  • Lines: 102

amāru I

  • Meaning: "to see"
    • G: (a/u) [IGI; IGI.DU8]
    • R: Mari
    • Gtn: iter. of G; Mari stat. "has learnt thoroughly"
    • Gt: jB "see from now on"?, mng. uncl.
    • D: rare; OA "examine" metal; cf. mummertu
    • Š: caus. of G
    • Št: "make s.o. meet" s.o.
    • N: pass. of G [IGI; IGI.LÁ]
    • Ntn: iter. of N 1

ana I

  • Logograms: DIŠ, NAM, ŠÈ

anāhu I

  • Meaning: "to be(come) tired"
    • G: (a/a) stat. "becomes tired", "makes an effort, strives"; of buildings etc. "become dilapidated"
    • Gtn: iter. of G jB med., of limbs, person
    • D: OA "tire (s.o.), oppress"
    • Š: Bab. "trouble, exert, strain" s.o.; stat. "is very wearied"
    • Št: "make an effort", "weary o.s., be depressed"; astr. "endure"
    • N: OB "become tired", "struggle, suffer hardship, be exhausted"
  • Lines: 35, 55
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/an%C4%81hu%20I

apālu I

  • Meaning: "to pay; answer"
    • G: (a/u; NB pres. once ihappal ?)
    • Gtn: iter. "pay", "stand in for" on separate occasions
    • Gt: "answer one another, have discussion", "stand in for permanently"
    • D: "be held responsible"
    • Š: "make s.o. answer"
    • N: "be paid off, become satisfied"
  • Lines: 19

apāru I

  • Meaning: "to cover the head" Bab., M/NA
    • G: (e/e, OB a/u) "put" crown, helmet etc. "on the head of" s.o. (= acc.), stat. "wears"; transf. of moon, star, king "be decked with" halo, radiance etc.; OB stat. of sheep's tongue "be covered, capped" ext.
    • Gtn: iter. of G, MA "constantly crown" king
    • Gt: stat. "is decked with"
    • D: "put headgear (= acc.) on head of" s.o. (= acc.)
    • N: "be crowned, covered"
  • Lines: 41
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ap%C4%81ru%20I

  • Lines: 107

atāru I

  • Meaning: "to be(come) outsize, surplus"
    • G: (i/i; OB(Susa) pres. iwattir, stat. (w)atar, Ass. utar) [DIRI]

awû I

    • Gt: (atwûm, later atmû) "speak" OA; O/jB(lit.) "discuss"; išti/itti X a. "negotiate with X"; ana X a. "tell X, speak to X"; OA "order (to do s.th.)"; jB itti libbīya (etc.) a. "think about" s.th.

awīlu I

  • Meaning: "man" [LÚ; jB om., med. also NA; Bogh. om. ZA] "human being" (also coll.); MA "husband"; "person, one"; jB, Nuzi a. ana a. "one another"; O/jB a. ... a. "one ... the other"; OA, OB "free citizen", also mār/mārū a.; "citizen" of PlN; as term of respect, OA, NA lā a. "no gentleman"; OB a. Ešnunna "man (i.e. ruler) of Ešnunna"; Nuzi, NB also "slave"; a. nāri (an aquatic animal) jB [LÚ.ÍD];

    • G: (stat. (w)ašaṭ)
